validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <onentry><send event="tick" delay="5 seconds"/></onentry>
    <transition event="tick" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: invalid value `5 seconds` for attribute `delay` on `<send>`

primary.message: pattern constraint violation: value '5 seconds' does not match pattern '\d*(\.\d+)?(ms|s|m|h|d)'

notes: the W3C SCXML 1.0 schema rejects this under XML Schema constraint `cvc-pattern-valid`
diagnostics.help: `delay` expects a CSS2 duration such as `500ms`, `2s`, or `1.5m`
